run_challenge_eval: run the NeurIPS challenge evaluation script with a model name and results file in NPZ format
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by comparing ML predicted energies against DFT ground truth energies
is_successful: check if the best predicted ML energy is within 0.1 eV of the best DFT energy
process_ml_data: process ML prediction results from an NPZ file and map energies to system and config IDs
get_dft_data: organize released DFT target mapping data into a nested dictionary for evaluation lookup
